message.content:
When a new drone arrives, I add it to the fleet by setting up its home site, checking its charging connector type, and making sure it’s compatible with the pads at that site. I also make sure it’s registered with the right sensors and battery specs so the system knows what it can do.

When a drone is worn out, I take it out of service and retire it from the fleet. If regulators ask, I can show records of how it was maintained and serviced. The old drone isn’t reused or lent to another company—it’s just removed from the system.
